pages.title: Load the Charge
pages.text: Load three Raw Copper, a fired Casting Mold, and Coal or Charcoal. Ignite explicitly with a supported tool. The mold is reusable. Bellows air is required; fuel and air never ignite a cold charge by themselves.

pages.title: Cast with Air
pages.text: Place adjacent Bellows with their outlet toward the furnace. Press them to bank finite air. Copper takes 240 active processing ticks and consumes one fuel when beginning. Reserve-fuel top-ups do not restart an active batch.

pages.title: Air Loss
pages.text: Air expiry extinguishes and pauses the batch. Restore airflow and ignite again to continue without paying fuel twice. Ready output stops the hot appearance. Each new batch needs ignition; retained progress or air alone is not a fire.

pages.title: Loading Roles
pages.text: Empty-hand use collects output; sneak-empty-hand use retrieves stored material. Normal insertion favours input and catalyst. Sneak-use a valid fuel to force the fuel role when a pack also uses that item as a recipe ingredient.
